body.p: The Git Branch Manager view shows the local and remote branches for the current repository. By default, it opens to the right of the editing area. You can open it in any of the following ways:

ul.li: Click Show Git Branch Manager in the toolbar of the Git Staging view.
Go to Window Show View Git Branch Manager .

section.title: Main Areas
section.p: The Git Branch Manager view is organized around the following areas:

dlentry.dd: Filters the branch tree by the text you enter.
Reloads the branch information for the current repository.
Shows the current repository and groups its branches into Local and Remote nodes.
Lists branches that exist in the local repository.
Lists branches from remote repositories, grouped by remote name and branch namespace.

section.title: Branch Tree
section.p: Use the branch tree to inspect local and remote branches. When you hover over a branch name, a tooltip shows information about the last commit on that branch, such as the author and commit date.
For remote branches, the Checkout branch action performs a checkout of the selected branch and creates a local branch from the selected remote branch.

section.title: Local Branch Actions
section.p: The contextual menu for each local branch includes the following actions:

ul.li: Checkout - Performs a checkout of the selected branch and switches the local repository to that branch.

li.p: Create branch - Creates a branch from the selected branch. By default, a checkout is performed automatically for the new branch. To disable this behavior, deselect Checkout branch in the Create branch dialog box.If unpulled changes are detected when you create a branch, a confirmation dialog box lets you choose whether to pull the changes before the branch is created.To publish a new branch to the remote repository and start tracking that branch, push the local branch from the Git Staging view.

ul.li: Track remote branch - Opens a dialog box where you can select the remote branch that the local branch tracks for fetch, push, and pull commands.
Merge "SELECTED_BRANCH" into "CURRENT_BRANCH" - Merges all changes from SELECTED_BRANCH into CURRENT_BRANCH.
Squash merge "SELECTED_BRANCH" into "CURRENT_BRANCH" - Merges all changes made on SELECTED_BRANCH since it diverged from CURRENT_BRANCH and records the result in a new commit on CURRENT_BRANCH.
Show in history - Selects the commit that corresponds to the HEAD of this branch in the Git History view.
